data.name: Arivu
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Tamil word 'arivu' which means 'new beginning'. It is a name that signifies the start of something new and fresh. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of the god Arya who is considered the embodiment of truth and honesty.
